config.selection: FungiTastic Mini Kaggle mirror. Exactly one lexicographically first photo per observation. Fixed-seed shuffle of species with >=35 distinct2022 and >=25 distinct2023 observations;first ten species with enough nonduplicate photos.20 train and10 validation observations from2022,20 test from2023. Reject file/pixel/perceptual duplicates within new data and against historical pilot image fingerprints. No model scores involved.
config.method: Reuse unchanged Head/train and sealed confidence_fresh pipeline. Fixed30 fungus visual prompts chosen before image/model evaluation;shared vocabulary,not per-image captions. Frozen EfficientNet-B0 ImageNet1K_V1 and OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32.7 arms,3 seeds. AG-inspired adaptation,not original paper replication.
config.holdout: Lock manifest/protocol before grounding. Ground/extract only300 train+validation images;train42 models using validation macro-F1 then CE. Seal all checkpoints and developmental assets before grounding/extracting200 held-out test images. One final scoring after seal; no test-based adaptation. Seeds vary initialization/batches;all seeds use same200 training images.
config.statistics: Six primary paired contrasts,weighted AG against uniform AG,text and shuffled confidence for each backbone;exact McNemar and5000 class-stratified bootstrap using three-seed probability ensemble;Holm across six. Also report seed mean/SD. A zero empirical bootstrap interval is not proof of zero population effect.
config.limitations: Observation dates2022/2023 are later than release of OpenAI CLIP2021 and ImageNet1K data;claim conditional on metadata accuracy. Not guaranteed independent of OWL-ViT pretraining,whose data provenance is not fully audited. Species concepts may be known. One image per observation,not photographer-disjoint. Closed-set custom temporal subset,not official full benchmark. No guarantee no overfitting or no indirect overlap.
